The relevant application details are hereby announced as follows: I. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens from Belt and Road partner countries, including but not limited to Vietnam, Laos, Thailand, Myanmar, Russia, Uganda, and be in good physical and mental health; 2. Applicants must demonstrate good moral character and have no record of criminal or improper conduct; 3. Applicants must have achieved HSK Level 4 or above; 4. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree, have an excellent academic record, and generally be under the age of 35. II. Scholarship Category and Language of Instruction 1. Scholarship Category: Master’s Program in Tourism Management 2. Language of Instruction: Chinese III. Scholarship Coverage and Standards 1. Tuition: Covered in accordance with the prevailing standards of the Chinese Government Scholarship; 2. Accommodation: Free on-campus accommodation will be provided, typically in shared rooms for 2–3 students; 3. Living Allowance: Provided monthly by the University in accordance with the prevailing Chinese Government Scholarship standards; 4. Comprehensive Medical Insurance: Provided in accordance with relevant national regulations. IV. Application Procedures and Timeline 1. Application Method Applicants should visit the Study in China website , click “ CGS Information Management System for International Students ” , and c omplete the online application procedure . Applicants are required to to submit application online. Website: https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/register Applicants are required to register an account and log in to submit their application online. 2. Application Period April 29, 2026 – May 25, 2026 T he Agency Number of Guizhou Normal University is 10 663 , and the Silk Road Program is Type B. V. Contact Information Contact : Ms. Liu Tel : 86-851-86759517 Email : lxs@gznu.edu.cn 上一条: ​2027 年贵州师范大学春季学期国际学生汉语进修项目 (非学历)招生简章 下一条: 贵州师范大学2026年国际学生招生章程 【 关闭 】 返回顶部 国际教育学院微信 地址:贵州省贵安新区花溪大学城 邮编:550025 电话:0851-86700476 86700348 电子邮件: sie@gznu.edu.cn 备案编号:黔ICP备13004003号-2 版权所有:贵州师范大学国际教育学院
